reading.title: Community garden volunteer notice
reading.passage:
COMMUNITY GARDEN VOLUNTEERS

Saturday, May 18 · 9:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.
Meet at the garden entrance beside the tool shed. Volunteers will prepare planting beds and label the new herb section. Bring gloves if you have them; shared tools and water will be provided. In case of heavy rain, the session will move to Sunday, May 19, at the same time. To join, register at the community centre by Thursday, May 16.
reading.imageAlt: Garden layout showing the entrance, tool shed, planting beds, and herb section

questions.label: Question 1
questions.question: When is the volunteer session scheduled?
questions.explanation: The notice schedules the session for Saturday, May 18, from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m.

questions.label: Question 2
questions.question: Where should volunteers meet?
questions.explanation: The notice says to meet at the garden entrance beside the tool shed.

questions.label: Question 3
questions.question: What should volunteers bring if possible?
questions.explanation: Volunteers are asked to bring gloves if they have them.

questions.label: Question 4
questions.question: What will happen if there is heavy rain?
options: The session will move to Sunday
questions.explanation: In case of heavy rain, the notice moves the session to Sunday, May 19, at the same time.

questions.label: Question 5
questions.question: By when must volunteers register?
questions.explanation: Registration at the community centre is required by Thursday, May 16.

questions.label: Question 6
questions.question: Which area will volunteers label?
questions.explanation: The notice says volunteers will label the new herb section.

questions.label: Question 7
questions.question: Which supplies are provided?
questions.explanation: The notice says shared tools and water will be provided.

questions.label: Question 8
questions.question: What is the main purpose of this notice?
options: To recruit volunteers for a garden session
To teach visitors how to plant herbs
questions.explanation: The notice provides details for people volunteering at a community garden work session.

questions.label: Question 9
questions.question: Where can a person register?
questions.explanation: The notice directs volunteers to register at the community centre.

questions.label: Question 10
questions.question: If the session moves because of rain, what remains unchanged?
questions.explanation: The notice says the Sunday session will take place at the same time.

questions.label: Question 11
questions.question: What is one task volunteers will do?
options: Deliver water to the community centre
questions.explanation: Preparing planting beds is one of the listed volunteer tasks.

questions.label: Question 12
questions.question: How long is the scheduled work session?
questions.explanation: The session runs from 9:00 a.m. until 12:00 p.m., a total of three hours.

questions.label: Question 13
questions.question: Which statement about gloves is correct?
options: They can be collected at the school
They are only needed in heavy rain
questions.explanation: The notice says to bring gloves if you have them, so bringing them is optional.

questions.label: Question 14
questions.question: What does the accompanying layout help a reader identify?
options: The locations of garden areas and the entrance
questions.explanation: The image is a garden layout labeling the entrance and work areas.

questions.label: Question 15
questions.question: What should someone do to take part in the session?
options: Register by Thursday at the community centre
Call the tool shed on Saturday
questions.explanation: The notice requires registration at the community centre by Thursday, May 16.
